## What changed and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a relevant issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran, including Windows/package checks when relevant. Identify failures, skipped checks and known limits.

Confirm that the change preserves session identity and lifecycle behavior, host verification, saved data and upgrade compatibility where affected. Remove credentials, profiles, private paths and terminal content from code, screenshots and logs. For vulnerabilities, use the private reporting route in SECURITY.md.
